## Description

Replaces linear error correction terms in VECM with neural networks while retaining fractional integration memory parameters ($d$) to capture non-linear cointegration spread adjustments.

## Where it may fit

Non-linear cointegrated asset pairs, commodity-currency cointegration baskets with persistent mean-reversion.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Macro Funds.

## Required data

Historical price series of cointegrated asset baskets, fractional differencing parameters.

## Caveats

Neural network training inside fractional error correction loops requires stable gradient backpropagation.
